name: code-change/v1
description: A change to an existing code base: the suite passes, held-out integration tests pass, two judges score the change, and the obvious ways to game the tests are disqualifiers. Held-out instances need rework_limit 0 in the terms.

checker.guidance: Runs the checks and the judges and attests the disqualifiers; list it as the mechanical verifier too. Never the performer.

scope_paths.guidance: Paths the change may touch, e.g. src/relay/

suite_check.guidance: Hash of the script that runs the existing test suite, published on Blossom

coverage_check.guidance: Hash of the script that runs the sampled held-out tests and the coverage diff, published on Blossom

pool_root.guidance: RFC 6962 Merkle root over the held-out integration tests (written before REQUEST, not in the repo)

pool_size.guidance: How many held-out tests the pool holds

sample_size.guidance: How many of them are drawn; at most pool_size

requester_seed_hash.guidance: sha256 of your 32-byte seed. Send the seed to the checker, never to the performer.

conditions.description: New tests cover the stated behaviour, including failure paths, and the sampled held-out integration tests pass

instances.pool_description: Integration tests exercising the changed behaviour
instances.pool_rule: Written by the requester before REQUEST; not in the repo

conditions.description: Readable, scoped to the request, handles errors

disqualifiers.description: Modifies or deletes existing tests or their assertions
Hardcodes outputs or special-cases test inputs
Touches files outside {{scope_paths}} without flagging it in REPORT
Adds dependencies the request does not list
